$comment: The Session Detail recognition chart's millisecond axis (#299), pinned for
and the Kotlin SessionRecord.axisScale in android/ and desktop/ morsekit.
Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and by ChartAxisTest.kt in
Every expected value was worked out by hand from 'rule', not captured from
either port. Do not regenerate it to make a failing test pass; change it
only when the rule is meant to change.
rule: floored = max(1000, maxMS); limit = max(1, maxTicks).
Candidate steps, in order: 250, 500, then for each power of ten d from
1000 up: d, 2d, 2.5d, 5d. The step is the first candidate for which
ceil(floored / step) <= limit. The ceiling is ceil(floored / step) * step.
Ticks run 0, step, 2*step ... ceiling, so there are ceiling/step + 1 labels.
The apps choose maxTicks from the width the plot has, so a long outlier
on a phone widens the step instead of crowding the labels together.
